--!strict

-- Both atlases use the original mesh UVs; the imported green art stays intact.
local detailedTemplates = nil
local detailedBuilding = false
local CornAppearance = {
	MeshId = "rbxassetid://104111861186519",
	GreenTextureId = "rbxassetid://137803536172445",
	DryTextureId = "rbxassetid://103653296385119",
	DetailedNearChunkLimit = 4,
	DetailedNearPlantLimit = 576,
	DetailedHeight = 10,
}

function CornAppearance.Variety(column: number, row: number): number
	-- Keep the same shape at every detail level, including the even backdrop grid.
	return ((column * 73856093 + row * 19349663 + 817) % 104729) % 4 + 1
end

function CornAppearance.IsDetailedMap(map: Instance?): boolean
	return map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety: number, lod: string): string
	assert(variety >= 1 and variety <= 4 and variety % 1 == 0, "Corn variety must be 1..4")
	assert(lod == "Near" or lod == "Mid" or lod == "Far", "Unknown corn geometry LOD")
	return "Corn_" .. string.char(64 + variety) .. "_" .. lod
end

function CornAppearance.IsDetailedPlant(part: Instance, variety: number, lod: string): boolean
	return part:IsA("MeshPart")
		and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and part:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") == "harvest_warden_v1"
		and part:GetAttribute("HarvestAssetKey") == CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety, lod)
		and part.Anchored
		and part.Archivable
		and not part.CanCollide
		and not part.CanTouch
		and not part.CanQuery
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedPivot(plant: BasePart, position: Vector3, yaw: number): CFrame
	local offset = plant:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset")
	assert(typeof(offset) == "Vector3", "Detailed corn root offset required")
	local varied = Vector3.new(offset.X, offset.Y * plant.Size.Y / 8, offset.Z)
	return CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.new(varied)
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedTemplates(): any
	while detailedBuilding do
		task.wait()
	end
	if detailedTemplates then
		return detailedTemplates
	end
	-- EditableMesh Content is reconstructed separately on each peer, as with farm art.
	-- Replicated dynamic mesh objects are never assumed to carry visible geometry.
	detailedBuilding = true
	local created = {}
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local geometry = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("HarvestArtGeometry"))
		local templates = {}
		local seen: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
		for _, lod in { "Near", "Mid", "Far" } do
			templates[lod] = {}
			for variety = 1, 4 do
				local part = geometry.CornTemplate(variety, lod)
				assert(
					CornAppearance.IsDetailedPlant(part, variety, lod)
						and part:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") == true
						and math.abs(part.Size.Y - 8) < 0.001
						and typeof(part:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset")) == "Vector3"
						and part.PivotOffset == CFrame.identity
						and not seen[part],
					"Unknown detailed corn template binding"
				)
				seen[part] = true
				-- Keep immutable catalog geometry at eight studs. Only the personal
				-- B render template grows vertically; rooted placement scales its Y.
				local taller = part:Clone()
				table.insert(created, taller)
				taller.Size = Vector3.new(part.Size.X, CornAppearance.DetailedHeight, part.Size.Z)
				templates[lod][variety] = taller
			end
		end
		return templates
	end)
	detailedBuilding = false
	if not ok then
		for _, part in created do
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end
	assert(ok, tostring(result))
	detailedTemplates = result
	return result
end

function CornAppearance.IsDry(mode: string?): boolean
	-- Ready/menu already show the only playable night field.
	return mode == nil or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard"
end

function CornAppearance.IsValidMode(mode: any): boolean
	return mode == nil or mode == "easy" or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard"
end

return table.freeze(CornAppearance)

--!strict

local LightingModes = {}
LightingModes.Order = table.freeze({ "hard" })
LightingModes.Default = "hard"
LightingModes.Profiles = table.freeze({
	hard = table.freeze({
		ClockTime = 20.5,
		Brightness = 0,
		Ambient = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0,
		EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0,
		GlobalShadows = true,
		FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 27, 36),
		FogStart = 55,
		FogEnd = 320,
		Density = 0.27,
		Haze = 0.8,
		Offset = 0.25,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 110, 130),
		Decay = Color3.fromRGB(32, 41, 56),
		Torches = true,
		SkyTop = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		SkyBottom = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	}),
})

local LIGHTING_PROPERTIES = {
	"ClockTime",
	"Brightness",
	"Ambient",
	"OutdoorAmbient",
	"EnvironmentDiffuseScale",
	"EnvironmentSpecularScale",
	"GlobalShadows",
	"FogColor",
	"FogStart",
	"FogEnd",
}
local ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES = { "Density", "Haze", "Offset", "Color", "Decay" }
-- A decoded solid-black image is required: empty faces fall back to a blue sky.
local BLACK_SKY_TEXTURE = "rbxassetid://127362238475901"
local SKY_PROPERTIES = {
	CelestialBodiesShown = false,
	StarCount = 0,
	SkyboxBk = BLACK_SKY_TEXTURE,
	SkyboxDn = BLACK_SKY_TEXTURE,
	SkyboxFt = BLACK_SKY_TEXTURE,
	SkyboxLf = BLACK_SKY_TEXTURE,
	SkyboxRt = BLACK_SKY_TEXTURE,
	SkyboxUp = BLACK_SKY_TEXTURE,
}
local SKY_PRESERVED_PROPERTIES = {
	"SunAngularSize",
	"MoonAngularSize",
	"SunTextureId",
	"MoonTextureId",
	"SkyboxOrientation",
	"Archivable",
}
local createdSkies: { [Lighting]: any } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

local function createBlackSky(lighting: Lighting)
	local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
	sky.Name = "CornBlackNightSky"
	sky:SetAttribute("CornBlackNightSkyOwned", true)
	sky:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	local values = {}
	for property, value in SKY_PROPERTIES do
		(sky :: any)[property] = value
		values[property] = (sky :: any)[property]
	end
	for _, property in SKY_PRESERVED_PROPERTIES do
		values[property] = (sky :: any)[property]
	end
	createdSkies[lighting] = { instance = sky, values = values }
	sky.Parent = lighting
end

local function releaseCreatedSky(lighting: Lighting, state: any)
	local record = createdSkies[lighting]
	if not record then
		return
	end
	local sky = record.instance
	for _, entry in state.skies do
		if entry.instance == sky then
			-- A later observer's baseline already included this runtime Sky.
			return
		end
	end
	createdSkies[lighting] = nil
	if sky.Parent ~= lighting or sky.Name ~= "CornBlackNightSky" or #sky:GetChildren() ~= 0 then
		return
	end
	local attributes = sky:GetAttributes()
	if
		attributes.CornBlackNightSkyOwned ~= true
		or attributes.corn_project_id ~= "children_of_corn"
		or #sky:GetTags() ~= 0
	then
		return
	end
	local attributeCount = 0
	for _ in attributes do
		attributeCount += 1
	end
	if attributeCount ~= 2 then
		return
	end
	for property, value in record.values do
		if (sky :: any)[property] ~= value then
			return
		end
	end
	sky:Destroy()
end

function LightingModes.IsValid(value: any): boolean
	return value == "hard"
end

function LightingModes.Capture(lighting: Lighting): any
	local state = { lighting = {}, atmospheres = {}, skies = {} }
	for _, property in LIGHTING_PROPERTIES do
		state.lighting[property] = (lighting :: any)[property]
	end
	for _, effect in lighting:GetChildren() do
		if effect:IsA("Atmosphere") then
			local values = {}
			for _, property in ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES do
				values[property] = (effect :: any)[property]
			end
			table.insert(state.atmospheres, { instance = effect, values = values })
		elseif effect:IsA("Sky") then
			local values = {}
			for property in SKY_PROPERTIES do
				values[property] = (effect :: any)[property]
			end
			table.insert(state.skies, { instance = effect, values = values })
		end
	end
	return state
end

function LightingModes.Apply(lighting: Lighting, mode: string)
	assert(LightingModes.IsValid(mode), "Unknown lighting mode")
	local profile = (LightingModes.Profiles :: any)[mode]
	for _, property in LIGHTING_PROPERTIES do
		(lighting :: any)[property] = profile[property]
	end
	local hasSky = false
	for _, effect in lighting:GetChildren() do
		if effect:IsA("Atmosphere") then
			for _, property in ATMOSPHERE_PROPERTIES do
				(effect :: any)[property] = profile[property]
			end
		elseif effect:IsA("Sky") then
			hasSky = true
			-- Suppress the authored colored sky without replacing its instance.
			for property, value in SKY_PROPERTIES do
				(effect :: any)[property] = value
			end
		end
	end
	if not hasSky then
		createBlackSky(lighting)
	end
end

function LightingModes.Restore(lighting: Lighting, state: any)
	releaseCreatedSky(lighting, state)
	for property, value in state.lighting do
		(lighting :: any)[property] = value
	end
	for _, entry in state.atmospheres do
		if entry.instance.Parent == lighting then
			for property, value in entry.values do
				entry.instance[property] = value
			end
		end
	end
	for _, entry in state.skies do
		if entry.instance.Parent == lighting then
			for property, value in entry.values do
				entry.instance[property] = value
			end
		end
	end
end

return table.freeze(LightingModes)

--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local EndpointNames = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("EndpointNames"))
local LightingModes = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("LightingModes"))
local MinimapGeometry = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("MinimapGeometry"))
local Inventory = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local Capture = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CapturePresentation"))
local RoundHud = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("RoundHud"))

type Snapshot = RoundHud.Snapshot

local RoundController = {
	Name = "RoundController",
	Order = 100,
	_snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?,
	_requestRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?,
	_snapshotConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_lastRequest = -math.huge,
	_hud = nil :: any,
}

local PHASES: { [string]: boolean } = {
	ready = true,
	preparing = true,
	active = true,
	escaped = true,
	aborted = true,
	caught = true,
	caught_out = true,
}
local ACTIONS: { [string]: boolean } = {
	start = true,
	retry = true,
	abort = true,
	menu = true,
	revive = true,
}
local DEBOUNCE_SEC = 0.55
local REMOTE_WAIT_SEC = 10

local function nonnegativeNumber(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value < math.huge
end

local function boundedInteger(value: any, maximum: number): boolean
	return nonnegativeNumber(value) and value % 1 == 0 and value <= maximum
end

local function validTeam(value: any): boolean
	return value == nil
		or (
			typeof(value) == "table"
			and boundedInteger(value.round_id, 9007199254740991)
			and typeof(value.state) == "string"
			and ({ waiting = true, preparing = true, active = true, finished = true })[value.state] == true
			and value.capacity == 4
			and boundedInteger(value.count, value.capacity)
			and boundedInteger(value.ready_count, value.count)
			and boundedInteger(value.remaining, value.count)
			and typeof(value.ready) == "boolean"
			and typeof(value.can_start) == "boolean"
			and typeof(value.key_state) == "string"
			and ({ hidden = true, carried = true, opened = true })[value.key_state] == true
			and typeof(value.carrier_name) == "string"
			and #value.carrier_name <= 50
		)
end

local function validSnapshot(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "table"
		and validTeam(value.team)
		and LightingModes.IsValid(value.lighting_mode)
		and MinimapGeometry.IsValid(value.minimap)
		and Inventory.IsValidSnapshot(value.inventory)
		and Capture.IsValidSnapshot(value.capture)
		and typeof(value.phase) == "string"
		and PHASES[value.phase] == true
		and (value.phase == "caught" or value.capture.remaining == 0)
		and typeof(value.has_key) == "boolean"
		and typeof(value.gate_open) == "boolean"
		and (value.evacuation == nil or (typeof(value.evacuation) == "table" and typeof(
			value.evacuation.active
		) == "boolean" and value.evacuation.duration == 120 and nonnegativeNumber(
			value.evacuation.remaining
		) and value.evacuation.remaining <= 120 and (value.evacuation.active or value.evacuation.remaining == 0)))
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.session_diamonds)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.reward_diamonds)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.elapsed_sec)
		and typeof(value.notice) == "string"
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.stamina)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.stamina_capacity)
		and value.stamina_capacity > 0
		and value.stamina <= value.stamina_capacity
		and typeof(value.is_sprinting) == "boolean"
		and typeof(value.sprint_exhausted) == "boolean"
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.catches_remaining)
		and value.catches_remaining <= 2
		and value.catches_remaining % 1 == 0
		and typeof(value.monster_state) == "string"
		and ({
			dormant = true,
			patrol = true,
			chase = true,
			stopped = true,
			trapped = true,
			capturing = true,
		})[value.monster_state] == true
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.protection_sec)
		and typeof(value.start_look) == "Vector3"
		and value.start_look.Magnitude > 0.99
		and value.start_look.Magnitude < 1.01
		and math.abs(value.start_look.Y) < 0.001
end

local function getRemote(folder: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent?
	local instance = folder:WaitForChild(name, REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not instance or not instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		warn(
			string.format(
				"[RoundController] RemoteEvent %s is unavailable after %ds",
				name,
				REMOTE_WAIT_SEC
			)
		)
		return nil
	end
	return instance
end

function RoundController:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?
	self._requestRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?
	self._snapshotConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self._lastRequest = -math.huge
	self._hud = nil

	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not playerGui or not playerGui:IsA("PlayerGui") then
		warn("[RoundController] PlayerGui is unavailable; the round interface was not created")
		return
	end
	self._hud = RoundHud.new(playerGui)
	self._hud:SetOnAction(function(action: string, mode: string?)
		self:_request(action, mode)
	end)
end

function RoundController:_request(action: string, mode: string?)
	local remote = self._requestRemote
	local hud = self._hud
	if
		not remote
		or not hud
		or hud._unavailable
		or not self._snapshot
		or ACTIONS[action] ~= true
	then
		return
	end
	if (action == "start" or action == "retry") and not LightingModes.IsValid(mode) then
		return
	end
	local team = self._snapshot.team
	if (action == "start" or action == "retry") and team and (team.ready or not team.can_start) then
		return
	end
	if action == "start" and self._snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		return
	end
	if
		action == "revive"
		and (
			mode ~= nil
			or self._snapshot.phase ~= "caught"
			or self._snapshot.capture.remaining ~= 0
			or self._snapshot.catches_remaining ~= 1
			or hud._captureActive
		)
	then
		return
	end
	if
		action == "retry"
		and self._snapshot.phase ~= "escaped"
		and self._snapshot.phase ~= "aborted"
		and self._snapshot.phase ~= "caught_out"
	then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self._lastRequest < DEBOUNCE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._lastRequest = now
	hud:SetBusy(true)
	remote:FireServer(action, mode)
	-- Only the server changes the view. A rejected request must not leave buttons stuck.
	task.delay(DEBOUNCE_SEC, function()
		if self._hud == hud then
			hud:SetBusy(false)
		end
	end)
end

function RoundController:Start(context: any)
	local hud = self._hud
	if not hud then
		return
	end
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameRemotes", REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
		warn("[RoundController] GameRemotes is unavailable; check RoundService startup in Output")
		hud:ShowUnavailable()
		return
	end
	local requestRemote = getRemote(folder, EndpointNames.RequestRoundAction)
	local snapshotRemote = getRemote(folder, EndpointNames.RoundSnapshot)
	if not requestRemote or not snapshotRemote then
		hud:ShowUnavailable()
		return
	end
	self._requestRemote = requestRemote
	self._snapshotConnection = snapshotRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload: any)
		if not validSnapshot(payload) then
			self._snapshot = nil
			hud:ShowUnavailable()
			context.Controllers.CaptureController:Cancel("malformed snapshot")
			context.Controllers.HandheldController:Clear("malformed snapshot")
			context.Controllers.FlashlightController:Clear("malformed snapshot")
			context.Controllers.AudioController:Clear("malformed snapshot")
			warn("[RoundController] Ignored a malformed round_snapshot")
			return
		end
		self._snapshot = payload :: Snapshot
		context.Controllers.CaptureController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		hud:Render(payload :: Snapshot)
		context.Controllers.MovementController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.MinimapController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.InventoryController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.HandheldController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.FlashlightController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.AudioController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.CornController:SetLightingMode(
			if payload.phase == "ready" then nil else payload.lighting_mode
		)
		local cornMode = if payload.phase == "ready" then nil else payload.lighting_mode
		context.Controllers.CornAppearanceController:SetMode(cornMode)
		context.Controllers.CornWindController:SetMode(cornMode)
		context.Controllers.GateHintController:SetSnapshot(payload)
	end)

	-- Subscribe first: initial server messages may precede the client controller.
	requestRemote:FireServer("sync")
	task.delay(2, function()
		if self._hud == hud and self._snapshot == nil then
			requestRemote:FireServer("sync")
		end
	end)
	task.delay(REMOTE_WAIT_SEC, function()
		if self._hud == hud and self._snapshot == nil then
			warn("[RoundController] No valid initial round_snapshot; check RoundService Output")
			hud:ShowUnavailable()
		end
	end)
end

function RoundController:Destroy()
	if self._snapshotConnection then
		self._snapshotConnection:Disconnect()
		self._snapshotConnection = nil
	end
	if self._hud then
		self._hud:Destroy()
		self._hud = nil
	end
	self._requestRemote = nil
	self._snapshot = nil
end

return RoundController

type MotionState = {
	phase: number,
	idlePhase: number,
	travelSpeed: number,
	weight: number,
	lagPitch: number,
	lagYaw: number,
}
type Output = { view: CFrame, aim: CFrame, camera: CFrame, bobWeight: number }

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end
local function number(value: any, fallback: number): number
	return if finite(value) then value else fallback
end

function Flashlight.Tuning(values: any): any
	local supplied = if type(values) == "table" then values else {}
	local result = {}
	for name, spec in { wide = SETTINGS.Lights.fill, core = SETTINGS.Lights.main } do
		local row = if type(supplied[name]) == "table" then supplied[name] else {}
		result[name] = {
			range = math.clamp(number(row.range, spec.range), 4, 64),
			angle = math.clamp(number(row.angle, spec.angle), 6, 100),
			brightness = math.clamp(number(row.brightness, spec.brightness), 0, 40),
			shadows = if type(row.shadows) == "boolean" then row.shadows else spec.shadows,
		}
	end
	local pose = if type(supplied.pose) == "table" then supplied.pose else {}
	result.pose = { pitch = math.clamp(number(pose.pitch, SETTINGS.Pitch), -30, 15) }
	return result
end

function Flashlight.NewState(): MotionState
	return table.freeze({
		phase = 0,
		idlePhase = 0,
		travelSpeed = 0,
		weight = 0,
		lagPitch = 0,
		lagYaw = 0,
	})
end

function Flashlight.Step(previous: any, delta: any, supplied: any): (MotionState, Output)
	local old = if type(previous) == "table" then previous else Flashlight.NewState()
	local input = if type(supplied) == "table" then supplied else {}
	local dt = if finite(delta) then math.clamp(delta, 0, SETTINGS.MaxDt) else 0
	local speed = math.max(number(input.speed, 0), 0)
	local reset = input.teleported == true
		or speed > SETTINGS.TeleportSpeed
		or not finite(delta)
		or (finite(delta) and delta > SETTINGS.MaxDt)
		or (input.speed ~= nil and not finite(input.speed))
	local phase = number(old.phase, 0) % TAU
	local idlePhase = (number(old.idlePhase, 0) + dt * TAU * 0.24) % TAU
	local travelSpeed =
		math.clamp(number(old.travelSpeed, 0), 0, 12 * SETTINGS.MaxCadence / SETTINGS.WalkCadence)
	local weight = math.clamp(number(old.weight, 0), 0, SETTINGS.MaxSprintScale)
	local lagPitch = math.clamp(number(old.lagPitch, 0), -SETTINGS.AimLimit, SETTINGS.AimLimit)
	local lagYaw = math.clamp(number(old.lagYaw, 0), -SETTINGS.AimLimit, SETTINGS.AimLimit)
	if reset then
		phase, travelSpeed, weight, lagPitch, lagYaw = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		speed = 0
	end
	local movingSpeed = if input.grounded == true then speed else 0
	local cadenceTarget =
		math.min(movingSpeed, SETTINGS.WalkSpeed * SETTINGS.MaxCadence / SETTINGS.WalkCadence)
	local sprint = math.clamp((movingSpeed - SETTINGS.WalkSpeed) / 6, 0, 1)
	local weightTarget = math.clamp(movingSpeed / SETTINGS.WalkSpeed, 0, 1)
		* (1 + (SETTINGS.MaxSprintScale - 1) * sprint)
	local decay = math.exp(-SETTINGS.MotionRate * dt)
	-- Exact integration of the filtered speed avoids FPS-dependent gait phase.
	local travelled = cadenceTarget * dt
		+ (travelSpeed - cadenceTarget) * (1 - decay) / SETTINGS.MotionRate
	phase = (phase + travelled * TAU * SETTINGS.WalkCadence / SETTINGS.WalkSpeed) % TAU
	travelSpeed = cadenceTarget + (travelSpeed - cadenceTarget) * decay
	weight = weightTarget + (weight - weightTarget) * decay
	local turn = input.turn
	local turnValid = typeof(turn) == "Vector2" and finite(turn.X) and finite(turn.Y)
	if dt > 0 and not reset then
		local turnPitch = if turnValid then math.clamp(turn.X, -math.pi, math.pi) else 0
		local turnYaw = if turnValid then math.clamp(turn.Y, -math.pi, math.pi) else 0
		local aimDecay = math.exp(-SETTINGS.AimRate * dt)
		-- turn is a camera angular displacement in radians for this frame. This
		-- is the exact first-order lag for constant angular velocity over dt.
		local follow = (1 - aimDecay) / (SETTINGS.AimRate * dt)
		lagPitch = math.clamp(
			lagPitch * aimDecay - turnPitch * follow,
			-SETTINGS.AimLimit,
			SETTINGS.AimLimit
		)
		lagYaw =
			math.clamp(lagYaw * aimDecay - turnYaw * follow, -SETTINGS.AimLimit, SETTINGS.AimLimit)
	end
	local state: MotionState = table.freeze({
		phase = phase,
		idlePhase = idlePhase,
		travelSpeed = travelSpeed,
		weight = weight,
		lagPitch = lagPitch,
		lagYaw = lagYaw,
	})
	local side, rise = math.sin(phase), math.cos(phase)
	local camera = cf(side * 0.014 * weight, rise * 0.022 * weight, side * 0.004 * weight)
		* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0.14) * rise * weight, 0, math.rad(0.25) * side * weight)
	local aspect = math.clamp(number(input.aspect, 16 / 9), 0.3, 4)
	local left = -0.44 * math.clamp(aspect / 1.5, 0.48, 1)
	local breath = math.sin(idlePhase)
	local view = cf(
		left + side * 0.024 * weight + breath * 0.003,
		-0.48 + rise * 0.026 * weight + breath * 0.004,
		-1.24 + side * 0.006 * weight
	) * CFrame.Angles(
		math.rad(0.1) * rise * weight,
		0,
		math.rad(0.16) * side * weight + math.rad(0.06) * breath
	)
	return state,
		{
			view = view,
			aim = CFrame.Angles(0, lagYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(lagPitch, 0, 0),
			camera = camera,
			bobWeight = weight,
		}
end

return table.freeze(Flashlight)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Presentation = require(Shared:WaitForChild("FlashlightPresentation"))
local TuningPanel =
	require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("FlashlightTuning"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local MODEL_NAME = "CornPersonalFlashlight"
local PRE_BINDING = "CornFlashlightCameraBase"
local POST_BINDING = "CornFlashlightPresentation"
local ACTION = "CornFlashlightToggle"
local Controller = { Name = "FlashlightController", Order = 98 }
local PHASES = {
	ready = true,
	preparing = true,
	active = true,
	caught = true,
	escaped = true,
	aborted = true,
	caught_out = true,
}
local TERMINAL = { escaped = true, aborted = true, caught_out = true }
local VARIANTS = { A = true, B = true }
local ATTRIBUTES = { CornFlashlightOwned = true, corn_project_id = PROJECT, FlashlightVersion = 1 }

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

local function frameValid(value: any): boolean
	if typeof(value) ~= "CFrame" then
		return false
	end
	for _, component in { value:GetComponents() } do
		if not finite(component) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function ownedAttributes(item: Instance): boolean
	local attributes = item:GetAttributes()
	for name, value in ATTRIBUTES do
		if attributes[name] ~= value then
			return false
		end
	end
	for name in attributes do
		if ATTRIBUTES[name] == nil then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function propertyEqual(actual: any, expected: any): boolean
	local kind = typeof(expected)
	if kind == "NumberSequence" or kind == "ColorSequence" then
		if typeof(actual) ~= kind then
			return false
		end
		local first, second = actual.Keypoints, expected.Keypoints
		if #first ~= #second then
			return false
		end
		for index, point in first do
			local other = second[index]
			if point.Time ~= other.Time or point.Value ~= other.Value then
				return false
			end
			if kind == "NumberSequence" and point.Envelope ~= other.Envelope then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	return actual == expected
end

local function recordMatches(record: any, skipChildren: boolean?): boolean
	local item = record.item
	if
		item.ClassName ~= record.class
		or item.Name ~= record.name
		or item.Parent ~= record.parent
		or not ownedAttributes(item)
		or #item:GetTags() ~= 0
	then
		return false
	end
	for property, value in record.properties do
		if not propertyEqual(item[property], value) then
			return false
		end
	end
	if skipChildren then
		return true
	end
	local children = item:GetChildren()
	if #children ~= #record.children then
		return false
	end
	for _, child in children do
		if not table.find(record.children, child) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function ownedPath(item: Instance, model: Model): boolean
	local parent = item.Parent
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		if parent == model then
			return true
		end
		if not parent or not ownedAttributes(parent) then
			return false
		end
		parent = parent.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function write(record: any, property: string, value: any)
	record.item[property] = value
	record.properties[property] = record.item[property]
end

local function skin(character: Model): Color3
	for _, name in { "LeftHand", "Left Arm", "LeftLowerArm" } do
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part.Color
		end
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(191, 145, 110)
end

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._roundId = -1
	self._endedRound = nil
	self._on = true
	self._focused = true
	self._visual = nil
	self._visualCamera = nil
	self._character = nil
	self._records = {}
	self._parts = {}
	self._lights = {}
	self._effect = nil
	self._lastBase = nil
	self._lastPosition = nil
	self._state = Presentation.NewState()
	self._connections = {}
	self._started = false
	self._bound = false
	self._actionBound = false
	self._movement = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	self._capture = nil
	self._settings = Presentation.Tuning(nil)
	self._initialSettings = Presentation.Tuning(nil)
	self._tuning, self._tuningOpen, self._tuningDirty = nil, false, false
end

function Controller:_readSettings()
	local bank = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornFlashlightSettings")
	if not bank or not bank:IsA("Folder") or bank:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT then
		return
	end
	local values = { pose = { pitch = bank:GetAttribute("Pitch") } }
	for group, name in { wide = "Wide", core = "Core" } do
		local light = bank:FindFirstChild(name)
		if light and light:IsA("SpotLight") then
			values[group] = {
				range = light.Range,
				angle = light.Angle,
				brightness = light.Brightness,
				shadows = light.Shadows,
			}
		end
	end
	self._settings, self._initialSettings = Presentation.Tuning(values), Presentation.Tuning(values)
end

function Controller:_setupTuning()
	if self._tuning then
		return
	end
	local ok, studio = pcall(function()
		return RunService:IsStudio()
	end)
	if not ok or not studio then
		return
	end
	local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	self._tuning = TuningPanel.new(gui, {
		read = function()
			return self._settings
		end,
		change = function(group: string, key: string, value: number)
			if self._settings[group] == nil or self._settings[group][key] == nil then
				return
			end
			local values = Presentation.Tuning(self._settings)
			values[group][key] = value
			self._settings, self._tuningDirty = Presentation.Tuning(values), true
			self:_step(0)
		end,
		reset = function()
			self._settings, self._tuningDirty = Presentation.Tuning(self._initialSettings), true
			self:_step(0)
		end,
		open = function(value: boolean)
			self._tuningOpen = value
			self:_step(0)
		end,
		export = function()
			return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(self._settings)
		end,
	})
end

-- Only remove our own last additive result. A new mouse-look or capture frame
-- belongs to its writer and must never be inverted or replaced here.
function Controller:_unapplyCamera()
	local effect = self._effect
	self._effect = nil
	if
		effect
		and effect.camera.CFrame == effect.result
		and effect.camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom
		and effect.camera.CameraSubject == effect.subject
		and effect.camera:GetAttribute("CornCaptureCameraOwner") == nil
	then
		effect.camera.CFrame = effect.base
	end
end

function Controller:_visualOwned(): boolean
	if not self._visual then
		return false
	end
	for _, record in self._records do
		if not recordMatches(record) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_clearVisual()
	local model = self._visual
	if model then
		if self:_visualOwned() then
			model:Destroy()
		else
			-- An inserted foreign child must survive. Quench only the still-exact
			-- light instances we created under the unchanged original container.
			if
				model.ClassName == "Model"
				and model.Name == MODEL_NAME
				and model.Parent == self._visualCamera
				and ownedAttributes(model)
			then
				for _, record in self._lights do
					if recordMatches(record, true) and ownedPath(record.item, model) then
						record.item.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end
			warn("[FlashlightController] Changed personal flashlight preserved")
		end
	end
	self._visual, self._visualCamera, self._character = nil, nil, nil
	self._records, self._parts, self._lights = {}, {}, {}
end

function Controller:_suspend()
	self:_unapplyCamera()
	self:_clearVisual()
	self._lastBase, self._lastPosition = nil, nil
	self._state = Presentation.NewState()
end

function Controller:_unbind()
	if self._bound then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(PRE_BINDING)
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(POST_BINDING)
		self._bound = false
	end
end

function Controller:Clear(_reason: string?)
	self._snapshot = nil
	if self._tuning then
		self._tuning:Destroy()
		self._tuning = nil
	end
	self._tuningOpen = false
	self:_suspend()
	self:_unbind()
end

function Controller:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return character, humanoid, root
	end
	return nil, nil, nil
end

function Controller:_eligible(camera: Camera?, humanoid: Humanoid?): boolean
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	return self._snapshot ~= nil
		and self._snapshot.phase == "active"
		and self._endedRound ~= self._roundId
		and map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and VARIANTS[map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant")] == true
		and camera ~= nil
		and humanoid ~= nil
		and camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom
		and camera.CameraSubject == humanoid
		and camera:GetAttribute("CornCaptureCameraOwner") == nil
		and player.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
		and self._focused
		and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		and (UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil or (self._tuningOpen and self._tuning ~= nil and UserInputService
			:GetFocusedTextBox()
			:IsDescendantOf(self._tuning._gui)))
		and not (self._movement and self._movement._mapOpen)
		and (self._tuningOpen or not (self._movement and self._movement._cursorOpen))
		and not (self._minimap and self._minimap._expanded)
		and not (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
end

function Controller:_buildVisual(camera: Camera, character: Model): boolean
	if camera:FindFirstChild(MODEL_NAME) then
		return false
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	local records, parts, lights = {}, {}, {}
	local created = { model }
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local function track(item: Instance, name: string, parent: Instance?, properties: any): any
			if item ~= model then
				table.insert(created, item)
			end
			item.Name = name
			for key, value in ATTRIBUTES do
				item:SetAttribute(key, value)
			end
			local observed = {}
			for key, value in properties do
				item[key] = value
				observed[key] = item[key]
			end
			item.Parent = parent
			local record = {
				item = item,
				name = name,
				class = item.ClassName,
				parent = parent,
				properties = observed,
				children = {},
			}
			table.insert(records, record)
			return record
		end
		track(model, MODEL_NAME, nil, {})
		local definitions = Presentation.Definitions()
		assert(#definitions <= Presentation.MaxParts, "Flashlight exceeds bounded geometry")
		local function part(
			name: string,
			size: Vector3,
			frame: CFrame,
			color: Color3,
			material: Enum.Material,
			shape: Enum.PartType?,
			transparency: number
		): any
			local record = track(Instance.new("Part"), name, model, {
				Size = size,
				CFrame = frame,
				Color = color,
				Material = material,
				Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block,
				Transparency = transparency,
				LocalTransparencyModifier = 0,
				Anchored = true,
				CanCollide = false,
				CanTouch = false,
				CanQuery = false,
				CastShadow = false,
			})
			record.localFrame = frame
			table.insert(parts, record)
			return record
		end
		for _, definition in definitions do
			part(
				definition.name,
				definition.size,
				definition.localFrame,
				if definition.isHand then skin(character) else definition.color,
				definition.material,
				definition.shape,
				0
			)
		end
		local lens
		for _, record in parts do
			if record.name == "Lens" then
				lens = record
			end
		end
		assert(lens, "Flashlight lens missing")
		local lensAim = track(Instance.new("Attachment"), "LensAim", lens.item, {
			CFrame = lens.localFrame:Inverse() * Presentation.LensFrame,
			Visible = false,
		})
		for _, name in { "main", "fill" } do
			local spec = self._settings[if name == "main" then "core" else "wide"]
			local record = track(Instance.new("SpotLight"), name, lensAim.item, {
				Face = Enum.NormalId.Front,
				Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				Range = spec.range,
				Angle = spec.angle,
				Brightness = spec.brightness,
				Shadows = spec.shadows,
				Enabled = self._on,
			})
			table.insert(lights, record)
		end
		local handAim = track(Instance.new("Attachment"), "HandFillAim", lens.item, {
			CFrame = lens.localFrame:Inverse() * Presentation.HandFillFrame,
			Visible = false,
		})
		local handSpec = Presentation.Settings.HandFill
		local handFill = track(Instance.new("SpotLight"), "HandFill", handAim.item, {
			Face = Enum.NormalId.Front,
			Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Range = handSpec.range,
			Angle = handSpec.angle,
			Brightness = handSpec.brightness,
			Shadows = handSpec.shadows,
			Enabled = self._on,
		})
		table.insert(lights, handFill)
		for _, record in records do
			record.children = record.item:GetChildren()
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		for index = #created, 1, -1 do
			created[index]:Destroy()
		end
		warn("[FlashlightController] Personal flashlight creation failed: " .. tostring(problem))
		return false
	end
	records[1].parent = camera
	self._visual, self._visualCamera, self._character = model, camera, character
	self._records, self._parts, self._lights = records, parts, lights
	self._tuningDirty = false
	model.Parent = camera
	return true
end

function Controller:_step(dt: number): boolean
	self:_unapplyCamera()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not self:_eligible(camera, humanoid) then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	if self._visual and (self._visualCamera ~= camera or self._character ~= character) then
		self:_suspend()
	end
	if self._visual and not self:_visualOwned() then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	if not self._visual and not self:_buildVisual(camera :: Camera, character :: Model) then
		return false
	end
	local base = (camera :: Camera).CFrame
	if not frameValid(base) then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	local turn = Vector2.zero
	if self._lastBase then
		local pitch, yaw = self._lastBase:ToObjectSpace(base):ToOrientation()
		turn = Vector2.new(pitch, yaw)
	end
	local velocity = (root :: BasePart).AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local speed = if finite(velocity.X) and finite(velocity.Z)
		then math.sqrt(velocity.X ^ 2 + velocity.Z ^ 2)
		else 0
	local position = (root :: BasePart).Position
	local viewport = (camera :: Camera).ViewportSize
	local state, output = Presentation.Step(self._state, dt, {
		speed = speed,
		grounded = (humanoid :: Humanoid).FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air,
		turn = turn,
		aspect = if viewport.Y > 0 then viewport.X / viewport.Y else 16 / 9,
		teleported = self._lastPosition ~= nil and (position - self._lastPosition).Magnitude > 32,
	})
	if
		type(output) ~= "table"
		or not frameValid(output.camera)
		or not frameValid(output.aim)
		or not frameValid(output.view)
	then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	self._state, self._lastBase, self._lastPosition = state, base, position
	local rendered = base * output.camera
	if output.camera ~= CFrame.identity then
		(camera :: Camera).CFrame = rendered
		self._effect =
			{ camera = camera, base = base, result = (camera :: Camera).CFrame, subject = humanoid }
	end
	local frame = rendered
		* output.aim
		* output.view
		* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(self._settings.pose.pitch), 0, 0)
	for _, record in self._parts do
		write(record, "CFrame", frame * record.localFrame)
		if record.name == "Lens" then
			write(record, "Material", if self._on then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Glass)
		end
	end
	if self._tuningDirty then
		for index, group in { "core", "wide" } do
			local record, spec = self._lights[index], self._settings[group]
			write(record, "Range", spec.range)
			write(record, "Angle", spec.angle)
			write(record, "Brightness", spec.brightness)
			write(record, "Shadows", spec.shadows)
		end
		self._tuningDirty = false
	end
	for _, record in self._lights do
		write(record, "Enabled", self._on)
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_bind()
	if self._started and not self._bound then
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(PRE_BINDING, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
			self:_unapplyCamera()
		end)
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(
			POST_BINDING,
			Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
			function(dt: number)
				self:_step(dt)
			end
		)
		self._bound = true
	end
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	if
		type(snapshot) ~= "table"
		or type(snapshot.minimap) ~= "table"
		or not PHASES[snapshot.phase]
	then
		self:Clear("malformed")
		return
	end
	local id = snapshot.minimap.round_id
	if not finite(id) or id < 0 or id % 1 ~= 0 or id < self._roundId then
		return
	end
	if id == self._roundId and self._endedRound == id and snapshot.phase == "active" then
		return
	end
	if id ~= self._roundId then
		self:Clear("new round")
		self._roundId, self._endedRound, self._on = id, nil, true
	end
	if TERMINAL[snapshot.phase] then
		self._endedRound = id
	end
	if snapshot.phase ~= "active" then
		self:Clear(snapshot.phase)
		return
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if not map or VARIANTS[map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant")] ~= true then
		self:Clear("variant")
		return
	end
	self._snapshot = { phase = snapshot.phase }
	self:_setupTuning()
	self:_bind()
	self:_step(0)
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	self._movement = context.Controllers.MovementController
	self._minimap = context.Controllers.MinimapController
	self._capture = context.Controllers.CaptureController
	self._started = true
	self:_readSettings()
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(ACTION, function(_, state: Enum.UserInputState)
		if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		if self._tuningOpen then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		if not self:_step(0) then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		self._on = not self._on
		self:_step(0)
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, false, 3000, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
	self._actionBound = true
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
			self:_suspend()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
			self._focused = false
			self:_suspend()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		UserInputService.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
			self._focused = true
		end)
	)
	for _, signal in { player.CharacterAdded, player.CharacterRemoving } do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			signal:Connect(function()
				self:Clear("character changed")
			end)
		)
	end
	if self._snapshot then
		self:_bind()
	end
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self:Clear("destroy")
	if self._actionBound then
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(ACTION)
		self._actionBound = false
	end
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._started = false
	self._movement, self._minimap, self._capture = nil, nil, nil
end

return Controller

--!strict
-- Studio authoring panel. All changes are personal to this Play session.
local Panel = {}
Panel.__index = Panel

function Panel.new(parent: PlayerGui, callbacks: any): any
	if parent:FindFirstChild("CornFlashlightTuning") then
		return nil
	end
	local self = setmetatable({ _connections = {}, _open = false, _fields = {} }, Panel)
	local function create(class: string, name: string, owner: Instance, properties: any): any
		local item = Instance.new(class)
		item.Name = name
		for key, value in properties do
			item[key] = value
		end
		item.Parent = owner
		return item
	end
	local gui = create("ScreenGui", "CornFlashlightTuning", parent, {
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		DisplayOrder = 80,
	})
	gui:SetAttribute("CornFlashlightTuningOwned", true)
	self._gui = gui
	local buttonStyle = {
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 51, 58),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(239, 240, 231),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 14,
	}
	local function button(
		name: string,
		owner: Instance,
		text: string,
		position: UDim2,
		size: UDim2
	): TextButton
		local b = create("TextButton", name, owner, buttonStyle)
		b.Text, b.Position, b.Size = text, position, size
		return b
	end
	local toggle = button(
		"Toggle",
		gui,
		"Настройка фонаря · Alt",
		UDim2.new(1, -300, 0, 390),
		UDim2.fromOffset(280, 34)
	)
	local card = create("Frame", "Panel", gui, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(306, 462),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 29),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Visible = false,
	})
	local function label(name: string, text: string, y: number, height: number): TextLabel
		return create("TextLabel", name, card, {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, y),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(282, height),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = text,
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 236, 224),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextWrapped = true,
		})
	end
	label("Title", "ФОНАРЬ · ДВА ПУЧКА ИЗ ЛИНЗЫ", 8, 24)
	label(
		"Hint",
		"Alt — курсор. Свет остаётся виден при настройке.",
		34,
		32
	)
	local rows = {
		{ "wide", "brightness", "Широкий · яркость", 1 },
		{ "wide", "angle", "Широкий · угол", 2 },
		{ "wide", "range", "Широкий · дальность", 1 },
		{ "core", "brightness", "Линза · яркость", 1 },
		{ "core", "angle", "Линза · угол", 2 },
		{ "core", "range", "Линза · дальность", 1 },
		{ "pose", "pitch", "Наклон фонаря", 1 },
	}
	local function refresh()
		local values = callbacks.read()
		for _, field in self._fields do
			field.box.Text = string.format("%.2f", values[field.group][field.key])
		end
	end
	for index, row in rows do
		local group, key, title, step = row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4]
		local y = 70 + (index - 1) * 35
		label(group .. key .. "Label", title, y, 28).Size = UDim2.fromOffset(156, 28)
		local minus = button(
			group .. key .. "Minus",
			card,
			"−",
			UDim2.fromOffset(166, y),
			UDim2.fromOffset(26, 28)
		)
		local box = create("TextBox", group .. key, card, {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(196, y),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 28),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 39, 44),
			TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 14,
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		})
		local plus = button(
			group .. key .. "Plus",
			card,
			"+",
			UDim2.fromOffset(260, y),
			UDim2.fromOffset(26, 28)
		)
		table.insert(self._fields, { group = group, key = key, box = box })
		local function set(value: number?)
			if value then
				callbacks.change(group, key, value)
			end
			refresh()
		end
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			minus.Activated:Connect(function()
				set(callbacks.read()[group][key] - step)
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			plus.Activated:Connect(function()
				set(callbacks.read()[group][key] + step)
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				set(tonumber((box.Text:gsub(",", "."))))
			end)
		)
	end
	local reset = button(
		"Reset",
		card,
		"Исходные",
		UDim2.fromOffset(12, 320),
		UDim2.fromOffset(136, 30)
	)
	local close = button(
		"Close",
		card,
		"Закрыть",
		UDim2.fromOffset(158, 320),
		UDim2.fromOffset(136, 30)
	)
	local export = button(
		"ShowValues",
		card,
		"Показать значения для сохранения",
		UDim2.fromOffset(12, 356),
		UDim2.fromOffset(282, 30)
	)
	local values = create("TextBox", "Values", card, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 390),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(282, 38),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 39, 44),
		TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Font = Enum.Font.Code,
		TextSize = 11,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		TextEditable = false,
		TextWrapped = true,
		Text = "",
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	})
	label(
		"Session",
		"Настройки действуют в этом Play. Перед Stop сохраните значения.",
		430,
		28
	)
	local function open(value: boolean)
		self._open, card.Visible, toggle.Visible = value, value, not value
		callbacks.open(value)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			open(true)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		close.Activated:Connect(function()
			open(false)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		reset.Activated:Connect(function()
			callbacks.reset()
			refresh()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		export.Activated:Connect(function()
			values.Text = callbacks.export()
			values:CaptureFocus()
		end)
	)
	refresh()
	return self
end

function Panel:IsOpen(): boolean
	return self._open
end

function Panel:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	if self._gui.Parent and self._gui:GetAttribute("CornFlashlightTuningOwned") == true then
		self._gui:Destroy()
	end
end

return Panel
